primary_sources.comparison: Structured deterministic application entropy with hardened BIP32 and HMAC-SHA512; not byte-compatible with forum raw HMAC-SHA256.
Extract and Expand are separate; Expand block counter is appended.
Node hkdfSync implements full RFC5869; runner comment saying Expand alone is inaccurate.
Currently unrecommended delegated event signing; kind/time conditions, no general immediate revocation endpoint.
Required status checks depend on configured branch rules.

inference: Improve user recovery with exact purpose/algorithm/public-identity records, consumer adoption checks and separate withdrawal of old grants; no new protocol or market/adoption claim.
